subject: Status of our shipment FRA to SGN, 1213 kg
body:
Hello,

could you please tell me the current status of our shipment: Hofmann Textilwerk KG, FRA to SGN, 1213 kg, ready on 2026-11-24? Where is it now?

Thanks a lot and have a lovely day!
Petra Hofmann
Export Desk, Hofmann Textilwerk KG

classification.reasoning: The sender asks where their shipment is and requests its current status.
